title: Great concept, great execution
body: Alleged “Extra long intervention” for settings lock being a literal standardized 10 seconds really ruins this app for me. My brain doesn’t have the executive function to maintain one sec’s interventions active with such a puny intervention for the settings lock. I love, love, love this app, but I have to speak out about this, cause this app is fundamental for me, but also ultimately worthless because I always eventually bypass it through the scheduled block setting. I mean, it doesn’t even make any sense to have a 10 second “extra-long” intervention for one sec’s settings while it simultaneously being only the third longest option in the order of 7 possible options (3s, 6s, 10s, 20s, 40s, 60s and 120s). Please, please, please, please add the option to increase the settings lock intervention time. It’s only logical. This isn’t a minor request, at least for me, as the lack of it literally makes the app meaningless for me.

title: Feedback
body: I'm using the Block Session feature. When I click on 'Pause Focus Session' and choose Instagram, after taking a breath and setting how much time I want to spend on Instagram, the app doesn't let me use Instagram even though I've chosen to take a break. Another thing: In this scenario I mentioned, when I open Instagram, the app directly displays the full Block Session screen without showing the one sec animation opening. However, when I click on WhatsApp, it's different; I can see the initial WhatsApp screen before being redirected to the one sec screen. The way it happens with Instagram, disregarding the bug I mentioned above, is much better! Also, I don't know why during the Block Session, Instagram has a darkened logo while WhatsApp doesn't.

title: Este app foi divisor de águas na minha vida!
body:
Sou TDAH e sempre tive dificuldades em focar e limitar as redes sociais.

Assim que instalei o app , fiz toda a configuração que foi muito prática e simples. Logo após, peguei para ler os textos que no próprio app e foi incrível!

Graças a estes textos eu passei a entender o quanto as redes sociais são prejudiciais. E isto fez toda a diferença, pq me encorajou mais ainda a seguir as recomendações do One Sec.

Hoje sou outra pessoa, graças a este app estou muito mais produtivo e as redes sociais não são mais um estimulo. 

Muito obrigado desenvolvedores, este app mudou minha vida e jamais teria palavras para agradecer o que vcs fizeram!

*indico usarem também o structured.
